videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Vincenzo leaves his adolescence behind and prepares to run the Florio empire.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Meeting Giulia turns Vincenzo's convictions upside down and shakes all his beliefs.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Vincenzo must choose between his love for Giulia and the prestige of the Florio family.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Palermo is ravaged by cholera, but Vincenzo comes up with a genius idea to save his empire.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: When Palermo rises against the Kingdom of Naples, Vincenzo must protect his family. Thanks to Giulia's intervention, he begrudgingly accepts a proposal by rebel leader Giuseppe La Masa. The rebels flee to avoid arrest and execution.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: When Angela receives a marriage proposal from a shipowner's son, Vincenzo refuses, preferring a noble marriage. However, Palermo has not forgotten the circumstances of Angela's birth and it is up to Giulia and Ignazio to defend her.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Vincenzo Florio is one of the richest and most powerful men in Sicily. Now it is up to Ignazio to invest in the future: to marry a noblewoman and renounce his love for Camille. Ignazio, however, is not like his father.
